notes.title: Version 1.1.01 Update Notes - Legacy of the Demon King, Mother's Trial
notes.notes:
After defeating the final BOSS, preparations for the return to the hometown are proceeding smoothly. At this moment, a mysterious character visits Erza's team, warning of signs of the Heaven’s Punishment event, while the wheel of fate for the Demon King is swaying violently…

The new version has adjusted the following content:
1. In the BOSS challenge room, the final BOSS challenge is now open. Players will be able to challenge the final BOSS in its ultimate transformation stage.
2. Adjusted the mana consumption and healing amount of the magical device "Tranquil Dew." Mana consumption is fixed at 350 and can be used in all stages of challenge mode.
3. Fixed the issue where the Sunflame Leg skill would still activate in the air after being turned off.
4. Fixed the issue where some monsters couldn't be hit after jumping.
5. Added missing barriers in some scenes.
6. Adjusted the positions of certain mechanisms to make them easier to recognize.
7. Adjusted some action modules after the protagonist lands from being hit, allowing the stance to recover quickly upon landing.

Free Major Update: “Legacy of the Demon King”
 Includes 8 new hidden areas in scenes such as the Glow Forest ~ Mysterious Cave, Desert Prison ~ City of the Ghouls; Added over 20 powerful new monsters and corresponding magic cores; Erza will inherit Eva's weapon; Super powerful new weapons, armor, and accessories will push the protagonist's team to break all limits; The rumored hidden BOSS will also make an appearance! Defeating the hidden BOSS will reward you with a new swimsuit for free! Additionally, there are some storyline completions that won't be detailed here to avoid spoilers.

Final DLC: Mother's Trial After purchasing this DLC
players will be able to fight Erza’s mother after clearing the game. The battle takes place in the virtual training room of the airship, where Erza's mother will test her daughter and disciple to see how much they’ve grown. This challenge can be repeated.
This DLC will be the last DLC for our entire game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39732262/deb09a6c8abeaba4548806e865f4490c300cdf50.png


After this major update and DLC, we won’t have any more large updates in the future, but we will continue to fix clear bugs. From now on, we will be fully committed to our new project and bring you even better works.

Sincerely, 
Icesitruuna

notes.title: "Frontier Hunter" Full Version is Now Available!
notes.notes:
"Frontier Hunter: Erza’s Wheel of Fortune" Full Version is Now Available! Enjoy a 10% Discount on First Purchases!**

Hey dear players, hello everyone!

The full version of "Frontier Hunter: Erza’s Wheel of Fortune" is now officially live on STEAM!

After more than a year and a half of early access updates, we have finally reached this milestone. We are very grateful for your support and encouragement!

We have worked very hard to perfect and polish the game, but due to the large scale of the game and our small team, if you encounter any problems, you can provide feedback through the STEAM community, QQ group (55042491), or official email: sitruunaice@gmail.com. We have staff stationed to answer your questions.

Thank you again for your company and support, and we hope you enjoy the game!

Here are some FAQs

1. How long is the game?
   Normal play without skipping the story takes about 30-35 hours, and perfect collection takes about 40-50 hours.

2. How difficult is the game?
   The game has two difficulty settings: "Normal" and "Easy". The main storyline is not very difficult, but the most challenging part is the "Realm of Souls (BOSS challenge room)". This room is for truly hardcore players, especially with the addition of the "Zero Stage" challenge in the full version. This is a special challenge that disables growth elements, truly testing players' skills. To avoid being too torturous, we did not set achievements for this mode.

3. Will there be major updates in the future?
   There will be a major update within 2 months after the game's release, involving the development of a plot foreshadowing, but no spoilers for now.

4. Will there be defeat CG?
   No.

5. How is the compatibility with Steam Deck?
   The game can be played on Steam Deck, but due to the large amount of text on some interfaces, enlarging the text will cause it to overflow the frame. Adjusting the entire interface would be too much work, so we had to give up optimization in this aspect. Therefore, if you play on Steam Deck, some text may be too small to read clearly. This is the issue for now.

Can I use modifiers or cheat tools?

In our game, some processes and certain data are interconnected. Modifying the quantity of items is very likely to cause some critical doors or mechanisms to become inoperable, which can corrupt the save file.


Kind,
Icesitruuna

notes.title: Full release date of "Frontier Hunter: Erza's Wheel of Fortune" announced
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you for your patience!

We are excited to finally announce the Full release date of our game: July 26 at 8:00 AM UTC.

After a year and a half in Early Access, the full version of our game is finally ready to be released.

“Frontier Hunter: Erza's Wheel of Fortune” is a Metroidvania-style JRPG with extensive exploration and development elements. Each monster in the game has its own monster core, which can be installed on weapons and armor for significant performance boosts. Additionally, the game features a smooth combat action system.

Following our final major update, we have created a lot of new content, allowing us to complete the game’s story. The total playtime to finish the game will now be around 35 hours.

We will also be releasing the final costume DLC simultaneously, which includes 9 outfits and 3 hairstyles.

Development Team: ICE Sitruuna
Platforms: Steam, Epic, GOG, PS5,
Total Playtime: Approximately 35 hours
Release Time: July 26 at 8:00 AM UTC, with a 10% discount on all platforms during the first week

notes.title: Summary of the First Year Since the Early Access Release and Outlook for the Off
notes.notes:
Some Summaries:
Sales Situation:
Our game has been launched on STEAM and EPIC platforms, with a cumulative sales volume exceeding 40,000 copies. The total number of unconverted wishlists on both platforms exceeds 200,000. 
    Currently, the highest sales regions in order are Japan, Mainland China, the United States, Taiwan, and South Korea. Although the total sales volume is not very high, it is enough to support all our development plans. We are very grateful for everyone's support for our relatively unknown development team.

Player Reviews:
Currently, on STEAM, there have been 830 reviews, with an overall positive rating of 86%. Notably, the game's overall positive rating once reached a high of 88%. However, it subsequently declined due to update delays and various bug issues.

Update Information:
The game has undergone three major updates in June, July, and November, nearly doubling the size of the game map compared to the original version. The main storyline now takes about 20-25 hours to complete.

Outlook for the Official Version

    We are currently working hard on the content for the official version. The map size of the official version will increase by another 30% on the existing basis, and the main storyline is expected to take about 25-30 hours to complete.
   Besides the main storyline, we will also add more hidden elements to the game (including hidden boss challenges that offer swimsuit rewards).

About the Release Date
  Our official version will include a PS5 version. A multi-platform strategy will better develop our future, and a simultaneous release will maximize the initial launch buzz.
   Since we aim to launch alongside the PS5 console version, we will focus on the PS5 version's review process first, after the official version's content development is complete. This includes Sony's review process and CERO's age rating review. Since this is our first time doing this, we may encounter some issues, making it difficult to determine the final release schedule. However, we can use this time to polish the game, minimize bugs, and optimize various aspects of the game.

notes.title: Significant Update: Version 0.8.01 has been released, start of a 25% discount
notes.notes:
Version 0.8 will be our last major update in the Early Access (EA) stage. From the early access version 0.5 to the current version, the total scale of our game's map has nearly doubled. We thank everyone for their support.
In the coming months, we will dedicate our efforts to producing the final content. The remaining map still has a considerable scale, but to expedite progress, we've decided to directly aim for the official release milestone. The STEAM official version will also be released in sync with the PS5 console version.

Here is a more detailed list of the contents for version 0.8:

Update List for V0.8:

Two new maps have been added, which means players who had previously achieved 100% exploration will see their exploration rate drop to 79% after the update.
Some characters have new skills.
New weapons, armor, accessories, and recipes have been added.
A new magical device "Storm Beast" has been introduced, which can be obtained at the "Altar."
Two new BOSS battles and their challenge rooms have been added.
Several new monsters have been added.
New side quests have been added.
New achievements have been added.
Three new pieces of background music have been added, which will be included in the current music DLC.
Additionally, some bugs related to the map's fog of war black blocks have been fixed, causing the initial position in the map "Forgotten City - Sinking Street" to be re-covered by black blocks. Therefore, even players who have already run through this area will need to visit it again to clear these black blocks of fog to achieve a 100% map exploration rate.

notes.title: Due to a colleague resigning, the update for v0.8 will unfortunately be delayed
notes.notes:
We are a very, very small team, with each member carrying crucial responsibilities. The resignation of our partner has led to a lack of some content. To ensure the completeness of the version content, the producer (myself) has temporarily set aside other tasks, fully committed to producing this part of the content, aiming to complete and release the 0.8 version update as soon as possible.

In the meantime, we have also found an experienced veteran with nearly 20 years of industry experience to fill his position. The entire team is filled with confidence and believes that we will be back on track shortly.

We are deeply aware that this delay may bring significant disappointment to players who have been looking forward to this, and we sincerely apologize for this. We promise that we will accelerate our work progress and present our latest achievements to you as soon as possible. Also, we will report our development progress and the latest news to you through the STEAM store community at the earliest time.

If you have any questions or suggestions, we warmly welcome you to contact us at any time, and we will respond as soon as possible.

Once again, thank you for your understanding, trust, and support. We look forward to bringing you a more perfect and captivating gaming experience in the near future!

Best regards,
Icesitruuna

notes.title: TGS2023 Event, Hairstyle Pack DLC Release, 25% Discount, V0.8 Update Coming！
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! In conjunction with the STEAM TGS2023 event, we're rolling out a 25% discount on our main game and introducing the Hairstyle DLC. Mark your calendars: this begins at Eastern Standard Time (EST): 9 p.m. on September 20th.

We've created a DLC that includes 9 universal hairstyles. As the main game goes on a 25% discount, the Hairstyle DLC will also be available for purchase.

Initially, we designed it so that each of the three characters could only use three hairstyles specific to them. However, we later felt that making all hairstyles universal was a better choice. As a result, we've adapted these 9 hairstyles to fit the faces of all three characters.

Additionally, we've optimized the facial models of the characters.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2559460/ss_f1d36c33454c79d79d6be40fc44f698170c7319f.jpg?t=1695204441


Now, for the main event! The hairstyles only took up less than 5% of our workload. We've dedicated over 95% of our time to creating new main content, which will be introduced in the version 0.8 update, set to release around the end of September or early October.

In this update, we're introducing two new level maps, two BOSS battles, and a plethora of new items, gear, and skills. What's even more exciting is the introduction of the most powerful BOSS in the game so far: the Guardian Knight - Alicia. This BOSS will be a significant milestone in the storyline, and after defeating her, players will break the seal and enter the realm of the undead. We hope this BOSS provides players with even more excitement and challenges.

notes.title: Version 0.6 has been updated!
notes.notes:
Version 0.6 has been updated!

Thank you all for your patience. We have finally released the 0.6 version, which includes approximately 40% of the content from the previous EA version. Players who previously had a exploration rate of 100% will see it decrease to around 71% after the update. We managed to complete the content in just over three months, which previously would have taken seven months. Additionally, this version incorporates some new technologies, which may result in increased performance overhead. We will work diligently to optimize it.

Here are the details of the update:
1. Originally planned as two maps, we had to split them into three maps due to technical reasons.
2. Three boss battles.
3. Addition of challenge rooms for new bosses.
4. Story progression now reaches approximately 55%.
5. Introducing a new scene rendering technique that enhances the depth of dark areas. However, due to the progress of our work, this will only be applied to the newly added level scenes for now.
6. Equipment loadout feature added, allowing players to save three different loadout configurations.
7. Guidance prompts on the main map to indicate what the player should currently focus on.
8. Teleportation stones feature added. In the late game, players will be able to obtain teleportation stones that can teleport them back to the base and also return them to the location where the teleportation stone was used.
9. Two new music tracks added, which will be included in the current music DLC.
10. Costume Pack 3 - Japanese Shrine Maiden theme.
11. New movement skill "Phantom Dash" added, allowing the player to dash through enemies and appear behind them.
12. Improved ability to quickly climb platform edges.
13. More magical tools, armor, and weapons added.
14. NIA gains a sword and shield attack style.
15. Addition of seven new weapon skills.

kind,
icesitruuna

notes.title: Update plan for the coming period, 0.52.003 update list
notes.notes:
Update plan for the coming period, 0.52.003 update list

In order to make the map and level content updates more continuous and complete, we may use 2-3 big level updates to finish the main plot part of this work.


The following is the tentative plan.

The current level of completeness is 50%.

With the 2nd major update, the game will be 65% complete

The 3rd major update, the game will be 80% complete

The 4th major update will bring the game to 100% completeness, followed by a full release.

We can't be sure of the exact timing of each major update for now, but basically there will be a few months between each one.

In between major updates, we will continue to improve the game's small details, fix bugs, and launch costume DLC at each discount.

After the official version, we will continue to update part of the branch elements, hidden bosses, etc. If the game's popularity can be higher in the future (the number of reviews exceeds 3000+), we
will allocate more manpower to add more new content.

Here is the list of

Dear Hunters!
After 18 months of game development, we’re working our hardest to make sure that we bring you the best quality of gameplay possible.
Unfortunately, this means that we cannot meet our original planned release date and instead expect the game to come out in mid-2022. We’ve completed various key elements of the game including voice acting, character design, enemies, levels, items, skills etc., and are now in the process of putting it all together, piece by piece.
We thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your continued support! We’ll continue to polish the game to perfection so that it will live up to everyone's expectations!
